launcher.notes: SharedPreferences 'launcher': all launcher settings. Read when Play is pressed: the launcher regenerates FFNx.toml and passes display options as intent extras to GameActivity. Force-stop before editing. Before any setting is changed it holds only update_checked. Other prefs files: companion.xml (bottom-screen panel state) and steam.xml (Steam sign-in token: never print or copy).

ffnx.notes: Regenerated from FFNx.template.toml before every start (renderer_backend, fullscreen, ff7_fps_limiter, speedhack_min, aspect, show_fps, mod options are set by the launcher). Hand edits are lost; use launcher prefs or the launcher's FFNx settings page. Created at the first start.

frame_rate.label: Settings > Frame rate
frame_rate.notes: Written into FFNx.toml ff7_fps_limiter before each start (5 is written as 3 plus a battle cap). Booster speed caps it at 3. From LauncherActivity in APK 1.1.40; not checked against a written value.
